svg.text: Every timed execution in measurement order · dashed lines mark whole-run percentiles
Dashed lines: percentiles of the full run.
Independent linear y-axes start at zero.
Spikes remain visible up to the maximum.
Run number is per task, not wall-clock time.
Apple M3 Pro · 2026-09-09 · Compute only · Same saved measurements as the percentile report · No outliers removed
